principle: FlowDocs shell dependencies must rely on governed Flow patterns. Topbar, Sidebar, and Search must expose typed contracts, controlled shell state, and no parallel mobile drawer close control by default.

checks.description: Topbar is authored in TS as the public shell contract.
Topbar exposes a single navigation action slot for small viewports.
Topbar navigation drawer is controlled by the shell state contract.
Topbar navigation action toggles drawer state unless the consumer prevents default.
Topbar navigation drawer does not render a parallel close button by default.
Topbar delegates navigation content to Sidebar instead of duplicating the shell list.
Sidebar is authored in TS as the public shell navigation contract.
Sidebar drawer state is controlled through drawerOpen/onDrawerOpenChange.
Sidebar drawer does not render a parallel close button by default.
Sidebar routes compose Flow Button instead of local anchor/button markup.
Sidebar groups compose Surface and Accordion for structure.
Search is authored in TS as the public shell search contract.
Search carries the semantic search role and Flow pattern marker.
Search composes Flow Input for query entry.
Search does not own global DOM behavior directly.
